Bug_Title: Dm: Futile attempt to change max pool size of ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor (DMI_FUTILE_ATTEMPT_TO_CHANGE_MAXPOOL_SIZE_OF_SCHEDULED_THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR)
Bug_Details:
(Javadoc)
While ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor inherits from ThreadPoolExecutor, a few of the inherited tuning methods are not useful for it. In particular, because it acts as a fixed-sized pool using corePoolSize threads and an unbounded queue, adjustments to maximumPoolSize have no useful effect.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by attempting to change the maximum pool size of a ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor instance. Since ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor uses a fixed-sized pool with an unbounded queue, changing the maximum pool size has no effect.
Trigger_Explanation: The test calls the'showBug' method of the ThreadPoolBugExample class, which sets the maximum pool size of a ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor to 10. The test then asserts that the maximum pool size is 5, which triggers a failure because the actual maximum pool size is 10.
